lessons: When DB file is missing and incident limits are reached, trigger a controlled last-resort restore with clear safeguards. Validate backup availability regularly, monitor restore thresholds, and alert early before cap is hit. Add runbooks for missing-file scenarios and post-restore checks to reduce repeat failures.

When a database file is missing and an incident cap is reached, trigger a controlled last-resort restore with clear safeguards. Add early checks for file existence, alert before cap exhaustion, and maintain tested backups plus restore runbooks. This reduces downtime and prevents repeated escalation loops.
